events.speaker: Alann
events.text: What should we do now? We are running out of coins to survive the week and quests have run out.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Maybe we should go check at the guild again. They should've gotten new quests by now.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: I sure hope so. All the remaining quests are just fetching quest which isn't that helpful to our finicial status.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Stop being so negative Alann. Things will work out in the end. Now let's go check the guild.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: A special quest specifically for us? That is really rare.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Told you, everything work out well at the end innit.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: But look at the seal, it is a black seal which means this is no ordinary request. We should find a secure place to read the letter.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: As per this request, we need you to save the princess of the near by kingdom, Faee. We got info from the spy that they are planning to throw a coup after the festival. So please make sure the rescue the princecss in time. If you accept the quest, we will give you a bag of gold coins and if you have successfully handover the princess to us there will be five more bags.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: F... FIVE BAGS OF GOLD COINS?

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: We can survive 2 winters with that amount of coins.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: That's if we successfully delivered the princess to them.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: High-risk High-reward as they say. So Alann, do we acccept the quest.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Well there is nothing to do for us anyway so and it had been a while since the last request so yeah let's do this.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Everyone ready for this once in a lifetime quest?

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Well I am pretty nervouce since this is our first time doing a quest like this. Usually are just slaying monsters and solving dramas.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Well we could expect this kind of quest in the future once we've successfully rescued the princess.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Easier said than done

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: Everyone is packed right? Then let's hit the road. Remember the faster we reach to Faee the better it is for us. We have to plan routes beforehand.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Yeah we could talk along the way. It will take a few days to get there.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: I guess this is where I sing a song before we leave to boost out morale- Everyone don't leave me behind.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: I wonder if the person behind the letter can be trusted..

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: It is a litle bit too late to think about that we are halfway to Faee.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: And we have already spend quarter of the bag to get new resources for everything.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Well yeah. But we should be worry about what kind of the person is behind the letter before we hand over the princes.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: I do agree. But we should be worried about how we are gonna leave the town without getting caught by the guards that will be after us like a swarm of angry bee.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: We should have enough time to plan a escape route if we made to Faee in a few days. We should rush before the darkness reigns over the forest.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: It's gonna be harsh on our horses.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Less speaking start moving.

events.speaker: Horse
events.text: <Finally we have arrived Faee, I can now rest until those finish their jobs.>

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: I'll go check the city for secure paths first later tonight.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Appreciated it. Ed, Za'el and I will be planning how we move at the night of festival.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: I am going to hit the tavern tonight for sure. The trip is tiresome without a proper rest the whole road.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Well we could rest a bit for today since we still got 6 nights until the start of the festival.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Just don't overdo it you two. Remember we aren't here for a vacation.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: I bet Jiiva would enjoy this festival. Especially the last night.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: It seems pretty much the same to me.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: You two focus on out mission. We weren't here to relax. Tonight is the most important night of our journey.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: You know if you're too much cautious and stiff all the time, the guards might think that your are up to something so just relax until we find the pricess and Jiiva give us the signal.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Oh there she is. THE center of this festival. Too bad she doesn't know what is hppening behind her back.

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: Thank you everyone for attending the festival. Please be at ease and enjoy this moment,

events.speaker: Peasant
events.text: Princess please bless our farm to grow more crops.

events.speaker: Guards
events.text: Don't cross over the line you peasant. Know your place. Bow down before the princess.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: I bet the princess is felling a bit unconfortable now. See you soon Za'el and Alann I have some places to attend.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: I think he is going to the princess.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: I just hope that he doesn't spill everything to her.
<firework exploding in the sky>

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: (Just how long is the festival).

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Hello there Milady, mind if I take a place besides you?

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: Eh how did you ge-

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Enough with those uninteresting topics. We should just enjoy this moment while it lasts Milady.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Milady do you enjoy this wine? This brand is my spefically from my hometown. This one right here is the best especially drink with

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: Ahem-

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Perhaps you are not that interest in the drinking. Well I guess a song will be perfect for you Milady.

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: I guess you are Ed?

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Perdon?

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: I am actually the one who requeted you to well "kidnap" me.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: HUH

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: Shhh you don't want to alarm the guards.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Well yeah, I am sorry but how and why us?

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: Well you four have quite a reputation in doing things successfully no matter how silly or dangerous the request sounds.

events.speaker: Guards
events.text: There is an intruder in the castle ground!!!

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: I guess that is our signal?

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Let's go for a walk princess.
A loud explosion can be heard towards the castle ground along with fireworks.
Meanwhile the other two at the festival.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Alann, the guards look like they are drunk.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: I guess they aren't expecting a company tonight since previous nights are all peaceful.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: I wonder how is Ed doing over there. He hasn't been captured by the guards right?

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: I hope so.

events.speaker: Guards
events.text: There is an intruder in the castle ground!!!

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: It's showtime. Now where is princes-

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Oh there she's. She is heading towards us? and holding hand with Ed...

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: WHY IS SHE HOLDING HANDS WITH ED

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: I would like to know as well.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: I've returend with my princess.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Let's haste. Everything will be explained along the way.

events.speaker: Guards
events.text: Guards someone kidnapped the Princess!!

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: How did you two get out before the guards noticed.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Well the pricess seem to have her own escape route planned.

events.speaker: Guards
events.text: There is the Princess, She is abducted by three.

events.speaker: Knight
events.text: Stop right there. Let go of Princess!

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Ed you look after Princess, Za'el and I will take care of them.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Just make it quick. We don't have the whole night to ourselves.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: We should be fine to go now.
Inside the castle.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: There really ain't that much guards in this castle. I guess they send most of their men to the festival.
How is the coup plan going?
Sir everything is going according to the plan. By tonight's festival end, we can start the coup.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: (So this is their secret metting area? It seems the other knight is a Lieutenant.)

events.speaker: Lieutenant
events.text: Is our men ready to do it the moment festival ends?

events.speaker: Knight
events.text: Yes sir. They are in the festival with normal wear. They can act immediately at your order sir.

events.speaker: Lieutenant
events.text: Good, you should take a short rest before we start the coup. The moon is going to be with us for the entire coup.

events.speaker: Lieutenant
events.text: Also tell the others to finish up final touching as well. We don't want them to join the stage unprepared. And make sure you lock the castle keep just in case we lost sight of the Princess.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: (I should follow the knight and see what is happening over there.)

events.speaker: Knight
events.text: Guys finish up your final touches. Captain doesn't want you to slow down the coup.

events.speaker: KnightA
events.text: We are fully equipped for the coup. We could even start it now if you like it.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: (There are a lot of them here even though the entire castle is pretty much empty.)

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: (This is a perfect place to start a show.)

events.speaker: Knight
events.text: Are you all prepared? We should move to our destinated spot by now.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: Now is the time!

events.speaker: KnightA
events.text: Who is there-

events.speaker: KnightA
events.text: Guh-

events.speaker: KnightB
events.text: An intruder? Crap he heard all our plans.

events.speaker: Knight
events.text: Don't let him escape guys.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: Too slow! Don't think that you all can easily stop me.

events.speaker: KnightB
events.text: We need reinforcements!

events.speaker: Knight
events.text: Make sure he doesn't leave the room, I am going to sound the alarm. We can't let him see another day.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: Guess I'll hang out with you a bit before I take my leave.

events.speaker: KnightB
events.text: Don't get all cocky just because you got us by surprise.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: I guess this is a perfrect time to fill us in Ed.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: I've cleared the escape path. But it will be crawling with guards if we don't move quickly.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: First thing first, Uliet here is the one behind the letter. It wasn't some secret country saving organization.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Well that explains everything.

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: Sorry but I need to kept it secret until last minute for safety.

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: I got a letter from the shadow organization saying that the knights are planning a coup and I overheard the knights while I was wandering around the castle.

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: And upon discussing with the organization in secret, they told me that you are perfect group to get me out of the kingdom safe and sound so I had them to send a letter to your guild.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: I guess the fill in the princess plan is no longer useful.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Even though we thought about that for the entire night.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: This is where we will be going on our way. Make sure you got Princess out of the city safe Ed. And you still remember the place where we are supposed to meet up?

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Don't worry I know. We'll see you three in a few days. Now go make distractions for me and Uliet.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Princess here change into those outfit so they won't notice you immediately.

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: Where do you want me to change?

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: I guess we could use that room over there. Don't worry I will make sure no one takes a peak on you.

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: Where did you even get these outfit from?

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Well I "borrowed" them from the store we run past through.
I feel sorry for the owner getting their outfit stolen.

events.speaker: Knight
events.text: Have you see our princess around here? She got kidnapped during the festival
Sorry me haven't seen the princess. But me did hear all the commotion from the castle.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: You done changing Uliet?
Just a bit. Also don't use my actual name in the public.

events.speaker: Guine
events.text: Call me Guine while I am in my disguise.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Well if you say so my Guine.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Now let's move without sticking out.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Za'el are you ready?

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Yeah I am prepared to make an opening once we are overwhelmed by the knghts.

events.speaker: Knight
events.text: There are here!!

events.speaker: KnightA
events.text: Hand over our princess. If you do, there will be no more blood shed tonight.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Instead we will be executed in a later date.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Don't underestimate us! Za'el cover my back.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Leave it to me.

events.speaker: Knight
events.text: Guh-

events.speaker: KnightA
events.text: Geather our forces. They may be strong but we have numbers!

events.speaker: Lieutenant
events.text: Let's see how skillful you two are.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Alann be careful. He is an high rank officer unlike others.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: I'll be fine with you at my back.

events.speaker: Lieutenant
events.text: Move, I will take care of him.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Za'el be prepared we need to make our move soon.

events.speaker: Lieutenant
events.text: Guh. You two got skills. No wonder you dare to kidnap out princess-

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Now is the time!

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Have you been outside of the city before Guine?

events.speaker: Guine
events.text: Tonight is going to be my first time going out of the city.

events.speaker: Guine
events.text: I wonder what exists outside of my city. I wanna try the food from different cities.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Well we could travel a bit more before heading to the destinated metting spot.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: But I think we should talk about that once we have walk past the gate.

events.speaker: Guine
events.text: Yeah but I am looking forward to my life outside of the gate. I'll be counting on you Ed.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: I don't think I can handle this kind of responsibility.
To Be Continued.?

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: I'm bac- God Damn the entire room reeks of ale. Were you drinking the entire night Za'el?

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Sorry, the ale deal was so good so I bought the entire barrel and ended up finished it in one go.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: You better clean the room after taking a bath. God, I better open all the windows to let fresh air replace the smell.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: <Burps> My bad G.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: Hmmmm...

events.speaker: Merchant
events.text: Well is there anything you like? Better be quick or others will buy ya marked thing.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: (I only have enough coins for one Spinosarus figure. Which one should I grab...)

events.speaker: Event
events.text: A few moments later

events.speaker: Merchant
events.text: Sir? you have been standing still for 30 minutes straight.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: (Maybe I'll grab both with the coins that Ed gave me for tonight's groceries

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: Well sir I'll get both figures of Spinosarus-

events.speaker: Merchant
events.text: Boy they all sold out 15 minutes ago.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: I wonder if he will like those flowers.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Is it for me?

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Yeah...

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: N-No!! What are you doing here Ed. Aren't you supposed to be performing right now at an event in townsquare?

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Oh that, I've done my part so I decided to wander around the city and I saw you entering the garden.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Next time don't tease me like that.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: These fruits seem fresh.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: But the prices though, they are a bit more expensive than the usual ones.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Maybe because they are from another kingdo-

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Ed we don't have enough time for a performance we got places to be remember.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: But this will be quic-

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: No but. Come on get moving.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: No don't you dare Ed.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Dude I am not even doing anything at all. Why do you hate me so much.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: I know you're gonna sneak into the castle and perform in front of the princess again!

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Well. . . .

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: We going back now.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: Well there goes another team from our Guild to hunt a Spinosaraus...

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Why didn't you go with them, we all know that you want to go to that Jurassic Land.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Nuh uh, he has been whining since the guild discovered a way to reach that island.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: You two stop the non-sense argument and pick a quest instead. We are running low on coins for this week.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: Can you do dinosaurs related quest? I want to see them.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Let's see my quest is to slay a giant Hermit Crab near this lak-

events.speaker: Fisherman
events.text: Nice day for fishing innit hu ha.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Eh.. Yeah it sure is a great day.

events.speaker: Fisherman
events.text: Nice day for fishing innit hu ha.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Yeah yeah I heard it the first time loud and clear.

events.speaker: Fisherman
events.text: Nice day for fishing innit hu ha.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Are you.. Can you even speak anything at all aside from that?

events.speaker: Fisherman
events.text: Nice day for fishing innit hu ha.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: (God he's stuck with one dialogue)

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Why is this path quiet. It is usually busy with all travellers and animals.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Yeah it sure is a bit weird.

events.speaker: MysteriousPerson
events.text: 止まりなさい皆の者.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: What language is that? Any idea Jiiva?

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: Sorry never heard of that language befrore. This is my first time.

events.speaker: MysteriousPerson
events.text: この先に大熊は 暴れているので 他の道を使んでください.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: Is he trying to warn us? or mug us?

events.speaker: MysteriousPerson
events.text: あいつは十人の命をもう奪った だからハンタータクト様が片付けてる途中に こちに来ないでください.

events.speaker: Alann
events.text: I think we should just quickly run past him.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: Yeah I support that. This conversation isn't making any progress so we should just move forward.

events.speaker: MysteriousPerson
events.text: 皆の物 あっちはダメです こちに戻りなさい-

events.speaker: Event
events.text: A few minutes later

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: I think we've lost that person. It should be fine to stop running.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Coming out of nowhere and started speaking in a language no one understands. Although I wonder that is he trying to say.

events.speaker: Jiiva
events.text: Maybe he is trying to tell us that there is a monster up ahead? If it is true we're done for. We didn't bring any of our battle equipments.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Ah

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Ed, don't look back and walk slowly towards us.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Why are you guys looking like that. Is there a giant bear behind me? Stop joking around keep on moving come on.

events.speaker: Kuma
events.text: <ゴホッ>

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: SO IT WAS A WARNING.

events.speaker: Mirako
events.text: ZZZ

events.speaker: Uliet
events.text: I don't remember horses sleeping like this.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: Guys I don't think we are supposed to dig in this ruins for the quest.

events.speaker: Za'el
events.text: Why? According to Uliet there are no curses in this ruin upon digging.

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: There sure is no curses but we awoken something instead!!

events.speaker: Ed
events.text: We should learn about the things that are buried in the ruins next time.
